apps.title: OAuth Apps
apps.hint: Apps that sign people in and act on their behalf through the OAuth web or device flow.

form.name: Application name
form.homepageHint: The full URL of the application's website (http or https).
form.descriptionHint: Shown to people when they authorize the application.
form.logoHint: Optional https URL of a square image. Without it the first letter of the name is shown.
form.callbacksHint: Absolute http or https URLs the browser may return to after authorization. Up to 10.
form.deviceHint: Lets command line tools and devices without a browser sign in with a one-time code.
